Window 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z .. 2026-08-17T00:00:00Z [Etc/UTC] (half-open: the start is included, the end is not)
Measured at 2026-08-17T00:00:00Z
This explains locally retained cost and tokens, not quota percentage.
The classes overlap — one session is also a project and a model — so shares do not sum to 100 percent.
A subject is reported as a contributor at a share of 0.20 or more of its named denominator.

Rules in force, by class:
  Prompt-cache churn: Turns whose prompt cache was rebuilt: the cached prefix collapsed and was re-created in the same turn.
  Short conversations carrying large context: Conversations with at most 3 human turns where at least one request used at least 80% of that request's model context window. With several replies the largest single request fraction is used, never their sum.
  Subagent fan-out: Cost attributable to delegated subagent work, grouped by parent. On Codex this is an identifiable subset of unknown completeness.
  Turn definition: main-thread human messages only — non-sidechain, non-subagent, after command and meta normalisation; assistant replies associate with the nearest preceding human.
